output.explanation: The warehouse doesn't track web shop visitors, so I can't answer this question. None of the available tables has web traffic, session or visitor data. They only cover customers, products, sales reps, orders, order lines and payments. A count of customers or orders wouldn't work as a stand-in for visitors, because many visitors never place an order. If it helps, I can tell you how many distinct customers placed completed orders in 2025, or how many orders were placed that year.
